items.a: Our lady Zaynab bint Khuzaymah (رِضْوَانُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهَا)

items.q: Our Beloved Prophet ﷺ said: "The first of you to join me is the one with the longest hand" (meaning); it turned out to be this Mother of the Believers, who gave much charity.
items.a: Our lady Zaynab bint Jahsh (رِضْوَانُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهَا)

items.q: Imam al-Bukhari's رحمة الله عليه book of manners, with many chapters on gifts and neighbours.
A waqf lodge for travellers and Sufis in Mamluk and Ottoman lands.
Our Beloved Prophet ﷺ said the best charity is to feed this.
items.src: Shu'ab al-Iman (al-Bayhaqi); wording to be checked

items.q: The Companion who sold his garden for a palm in Paradise after the verse of the "goodly loan" (2:245) came down.
The Companion who brought a sa' of dates that he earned by drawing water, and was mocked by the hypocrites.
items.src: Sahih al-Bukhari (Fath al-Bari); name to be checked

items.q: Our Beloved Prophet ﷺ said the miser is far from Allah and from this.
items.src: Sunan al-Tirmidhi; grade to be checked

items.q: Our Beloved Master ﷺ told Bilal (رِضْوَانُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ) to spend and not fear that the Lord of the Throne would do this (paraphrased).
